contentHtml:
A maid visa comes in handy when your sponsor is flying you to Dubai for your maid services. It may seem complicated at surface but worry not as Connect Freelance has got your back. We bring you this article to teach you everything about getting your maid visa.

Thanks to this article, you will learn everything about getting your maid visa. The following is an overview of the process that you would need to follow to get it.

1. Why do you need to have a visa in Dubai?

You need a visa in Dubai to remain legally compliant with the UAE laws. You have to be in possession of the right visa for your intended purpose to be in Dubai.

2. What do you need to know before applying for a maid visa?

Here’s what you need to know before applying for a maid visa:

However, applying for a maid visa comes with its own set of challenges, such as getting approval by authorities or even getting into Dubai in the first place. And Connect Freelancer is here to help you.

You need it to work in Dubai

Maid visas are issued to maids who come to Dubai to help out by:

  • Taking care of children
  • Looking after the elderly

You can use your sponsor

The sponsorship process for the maid visa starts with an agreement between the sponsor and the maid. The deal includes all the terms and conditions related to her employment.

  • An agreement between the sponsor and the maid which includes all the terms and conditions related to her employment 
  • The sponsor pays for all these expenses before getting their sponsorship approved by the authorities
  • Once they get approval from the authorities, they apply for their work visa
  • It will allow them to bring their maid into the UAE legally

Remember to check your passport

One of the first steps is to check the state of your passport.

If you want to apply for a maid visa, it is essential that you take care of this step before learning more about the cost of the maid visa in Dubai in 2021. If your passport is not updated, you will not be able to apply for the visa and need to renew it first.

Remember to check if you need a lawyer

Speak to an immigration lawyer to handle all the paperwork.

If your employer is sponsoring your maid visa application, then it is likely that they will have their immigration lawyer who can handle all of the paperwork. In this case, there is no need for you to hire a visa agent. However, if you are trying to apply yourself, it would be beneficial to consult with an immigration lawyer or visa agent who can help guide you through the process.

3. What is the process of obtaining a maid visa in Dubai?

These are the process steps to obtain your maid visa:

3.1 You need to have your employment permit approved

Before applying for the maid’s employment permit, the employer must have a valid work permit. They will need to apply for one of these permits from their home country.

The application process for a maid visa is very different from a work permit. The employer needs to submit a lot more documentation, and they need to provide more information on their background and that of the maid. The employer also needs to interview immigration officials before being granted permission to employ a foreign domestic helper.

3.1 You need to have your employment permit approved

The UAE has strict rules and regulations that govern the hiring of maids. These rules protect the maids from exploitation and ensure that they are well cared for.

Before applying for the maid’s employment permit, the employer must have a valid work permit. They will apply for one of these permits from their home country. The employer needs to submit a lot more documentation, and they have to provide more information on their background and that of the maid. The employer also needs to interview immigration officials before being granted permission to employ a foreign domestic helper.

3.2 Your sponsor needs a Medical Fitness Report

It is illegal to sponsor a housemaid in the UAE without first completing the medical fitness report and registering for the Emirates Identity card. A new maid should then be offered a contract that includes the conditions of employment. A new employee should then be offered a contract containing the employment conditions.

3.3 You need a residence stamp

The UAE government requires all maids to have their residence stamps on their passports before working in the country. This stamp needs to be renewed every few years or expires, whichever comes first.

4. Do you need to research the immigration laws and regulations of the UAE?

Foreigners get a visa before entering the country or applying for residency permits there. They also get their residence permits renewed periodically by submitting documents like:

  • copies of their passports
  • employment contracts
  • salary slips every few months

5. How to prepare yourself mentally for your interview with the UAE embassy officials?

Interviewing for a work permit in the UAE might seem stressful. This stress can be avoided by being prepared. Know all the correct information and understand what is expected at the interview.

The UAE embassy officials will ask you about:

  • Your qualifications
  • job experience
  • how much money you make in your home country
  • why you want to work in Dubai
  • you have to provide them with any references
  • Update your CV
  • Research different job openings in Dubai 
  • Be prepared for question like why you want to work here

6. What are the maid visa requirements?

The eligibility criteria for the Dubai maid visa are as follows:

– The sponsor is:

  • a UAE resident or citizen with a valid residency card.
  • at least 21 years old
  • can provide proof of income
  • does not have any outstanding debts or criminal records in Dubai

– You have been living in the UAE for at least two years before applying for the visa.

7. Do you need to wait for your approval?

Whether you need to wait far longer or not largely depends on the employer-employee relationship between the applicant and sponsor. The more information provided about this relationship, the faster your application will be processed.

8. How to get ready to live in Dubai?

This country is a critical player in the global economy. It is a central financial and business hub for the Middle East and Africa. You will find it to be a hub for:

  • international trade
  • Finance
  • Tourism
  • Transport

This place has been ranked as one of the top places to live due to its excellent lifestyle options, including:

  • Luxury shopping malls
  • Sports facilities
  • Schools
  • Hospitals

9. Can you tell the advantages of hiring a domestic worker?

There are many benefits to having an overseas domestic worker with a housemaid visa in Dubai. If you need someone to help you with your household tasks, then an overseas domestic worker is a perfect choice. They are also great for:

  • people who have disabilities
  • Those who cannot do specific jobs because of their age.

The financial benefits are usually the most important ones. They allow you to save money on your monthly bills and grocery shopping by doing all the shopping and cooking for you.
